verdict.rationale: Copilot offers 'connectors' that link it to other services, available on Copilot.com and mobile. However, the documented set is a short fixed list: Microsoft OneDrive and Outlook.com plus Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar and Contacts. Nothing shows a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps, so this is only glancing support for the story. Missing for 10: a browsable app/connector directory or marketplace, a broad third-party catalog beyond Google services, documented add/enable flow details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
